content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Many creators in Kenya face obstacles when using conventional payment platforms due to geographic restrictions and regulatory hurdles. By leveraging blockchain technology and Cloudflare's infrastructure, you eliminate reliance on third-party services that may deny access. A decentralized payment structure ensures you can accept cryptocurrencies like USDT on Tron, which settle in under 60 seconds for minimal fees. This approach empowers you to control your sales process completely, allowing you to focus on what you do best: creating and selling digital products.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you begin deployment, ensure you have the necessary resources at hand. Start with a reliable hosting option like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for effortless website management. You also need a backend solution such as Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for processing transactions. Moreover, integrate Supabase for your order storage and NOWPayments for seamless crypto payment verification. Finally, prepare your digital products, ensuring they are ready for instant delivery upon purchase. This setup streamlines your entire sales process, laying the groundwork for a successful operation.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your payment processing system using NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. This provider ensures automatic payment verification with a low transaction fee of 0.5%. Next, set up your order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets, where you can manage customer data efficiently. For file delivery, use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to distribute your ebooks instantly after payment confirmation. This pipeline not only ensures a smooth transaction experience but also offers your customers immediate access to their purchases, enhancing satisfaction and trust.
No subscriptions, no limitations — you own everything after deployment.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is in place, it's time to go live. Make sure your website is fully operational and all links are functional. Promote your ebooks through social media and other channels to attract potential buyers. When processing your first transaction, monitor the payment verification through NOWPayments to ensure everything functions correctly. If a customer completes a transaction, their ebook should be delivered automatically via your chosen file delivery method. This initial transaction will provide valuable insights into your operations, allowing you to identify any areas for improvement.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your initial sales are successful, focus on scaling your operations. Expand your product offerings by adding more ebooks or diversifying into other digital products like courses or templates. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for additional blueprints and templates to enhance your store's functionality. Consider utilizing Binance P2P for expanding your payment methods, as it supports local currencies like the Kenyan shilling. Regularly analyze your sales data to identify trends and opportunities for growth, ensuring your infrastructure evolves alongside your business.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
Instant payment confirmations mean immediate product delivery for your customers.

Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept payments in Nigeria for digital products?

You can accept payments in Nigeria by integrating NOWPayments, which allows transactions in various cryptocurrencies. This method circumvents traditional platforms like Stripe or PayPal, offering a direct payment option without geographic restrictions.
What payment methods are available for creators in Kenya?

Creators in Kenya can utilize blockchain-based payment methods such as NOWPayments for accepting cryptocurrencies. This approach ensures a seamless transaction process without reliance on conventional payment platforms that may be unavailable.
Can I sell ebooks from Pakistan without Stripe?

Yes, you can sell ebooks from Pakistan using NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This system allows you to bypass Stripe and accept payments directly from your customers using various cryptocurrencies.
How do I ensure product delivery after payment?

To ensure product delivery after payment, utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for hosting your ebooks. Integrate these with NOWPayments, which triggers automatic delivery upon payment confirmation, ensuring customers receive their products instantly.
What are the advantages of using blockchain for payments?

Blockchain payments offer low fees, quick transaction times, and the ability to operate without centralized control. This infrastructure grants you sovereignty over your sales process, enabling direct transactions with customers globally.
Leverage decentralized payments to unlock global sales opportunities.
